observations: Six retail boxes for Syinix Electric Kettles are stacked on a larger carton.
The boxes are labeled 'Syinix' and 'ELECTRIC KETTLE'.
Specifications on the boxes include '2.2 Litres', '2000W', 'Longer Copper Cord', and 'Food Grade Stainless Steel'.
A Standards Organisation of Nigeria (SON) logo is visible on the retail boxes.
The large shipping carton is also branded Syinix and specifies '2.2L / 2000W'.
No photo shows the actual kettle outside of its packaging.
